profiles.name: Volkswagen, Skoda (Hiworld VWP004, MQB)
profiles.description: Hiworld box, protocol VWP004 (Volkswagen MQB), from Hiworld's own app (HdMQB7Protocol). This box needs no car type: the car chosen only names it. Older Volkswagen cars that Hiworld's catalogue lists with this box but its app decodes as VWP003 are in vw-pq-hiworld. Not tried on a car yet.

profiles.name: Volkswagen, Skoda (Raise / Oudi, MQB)
profiles.description: Raise (RZC) or Oudi box, Volkswagen MQB protocol, from the decoder Hiworld's own app uses for these boxes (ReMQB7Protocol); the cars are the ones that app decodes with it. The head unit says hello once (0x81 01) and acknowledges each message (FF); no car type. Not tried on a car yet. Cars marked « (same protocol) » have no decoder in Car Info: their box maker's protocol document is the one this decoder implements.
